Reminder.title: Reminder
Reminder.description: A user-owned reminder scheduled for a daily routine, monthly cycle, or yearly milestone.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the reminder owner.

title.description: Short title of the task or event to remember (1 to 120 characters).

notes.description: Optional notes or checklist context (up to 500 characters).

category.description: Visual category tag for organizing reminders.

hour.description: Hour of day (0-23) when the reminder notifies.

minute.description: Minute of hour (0-59) when the reminder notifies.

dayOfMonth.description: Day of month (1-31) for MONTHLY and YEARLY reminders.

monthOfYear.description: Month of year (1-12) for YEARLY reminders.

recurring.description: Whether the reminder repeats automatically each cycle.

paused.description: Whether notifications and due status are paused.

lastCompletedCycleKey.description: Cycle key (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or YYYY) when last completed.

completedCount.description: Total number of times the reminder has been completed.

snoozedUntilEpochMs.description: Epoch milliseconds until snoozed, or 0 if not snoozed.

updatedAt.description: Server-assigned last update timestamp via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/reminders/{reminderId}.description: Private daily, monthly, and yearly reminders owned by the authenticated user.
